name: Fudo
description: Fudo restaurant point of sale: sales and tickets with items and payments, payments and payment methods, customers, products and menu categories, expenses with their purchased lines, expense payments and categories, suppliers, ingredients and stock, tables, rooms, kitchens, staff and roles. Fudo API v1alpha1 with an API key and secret; writes are included but installed switched off.
prerequisites: API credentials (an apiKey and apiSecret) issued by Fudo support: write to soporte@fu.do with your account name and the user that should get API access.
instructions:
## Fudo
Fudo is a point-of-sale and management system for restaurants, bars and cafes, used mainly in Argentina and the rest of Latin America and in Spain. This connector reads the Fudo API v1alpha1 (`https://api.fu.do/v1alpha1`), a JSON:API: every answer has `data` with `id`, `type` and `attributes`, plus `included` when relations are embedded.

## Setup
1. Fudo issues API credentials on request: write to soporte@fu.do with the name of your Fudo account and the user that should get API access. Fudo recommends a dedicated user such as api@mirestaurante; the API can do what that user's role allows.
2. Put the `apiKey` into `FUDO_API_KEY` and the `apiSecret` into `FUDO_API_SECRET`.
3. The connector exchanges them at `POST https://auth.fu.do/api` for a token valid 24 hours and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer`. It renews the token before it expires. The key and secret are never sent to api.fu.do directly; sending them as headers there returns 401.

## Start here
- `fudo_list_payment_methods` checks the credentials and gives the method ids.
- Sales of a day: `fudo_list_sales` with `created_at` = `and(gte.2026-10-06T00:00:00Z,lte.2026-10-06T23:59:59Z)`, `sale_state` = `in.(CLOSED)` and `include` = `payments.paymentMethod` or `items.product`.
- Occupied tables: `fudo_list_tables` with `include=activeSales`.
- Menu: `fudo_list_product_categories` with `include=products`, or `fudo_list_products`.

## Filters
Filter parameters take Fudo's operator expressions as documented: `eq.`, `neq.`, `gte.`, `lte.`, `in.(a,b)`, `ilike.%text%`, `is.null`, `isdistinct.null`, and `and(gte.x,lte.y)` for ranges. Times are ISO 8601 with Z (UTC), dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Some parameters (active, ids, table_id, user_id, provider_id, search, name) take the plain value and the connector adds the operator. Fudo validates each expression against a per-column pattern and answers 400 or 422 when the form is not accepted; the parameter descriptions give the accepted forms.

## Pagination
`page_size` (default 250, max 500) and `page_number` (from 1). There is no total count: keep requesting pages until a page has fewer items than `page_size`.

## Include
Most tools take `include`, a comma-separated list of relations to embed (for example `items.product,payments.paymentMethod` on a sale). Embedded records arrive in `included`, linked from `relationships`.

## Fields
Fudo only returns the attributes a request asks for on some resources. Expenses, expense categories and providers would come back with ids only, so the connector asks for their fields itself.

## Expenses, stock and units
- An expense's purchased lines are `expenseItems`: `detail`, `quantity`, `price` and the linked `ingredient` or `product`. Read them with `include=expenseItems.ingredient.unit`.
- The Fudo API cannot create or change expense items: `fudo_create_expense` records the header only, so stock does not move. To book a purchase into stock, update each ingredient with `fudo_update_ingredient` (stock is absolute: current stock from `fudo_get_ingredient` plus the purchased quantity).
- Units have no endpoint of their own. They come with `include=unit` on ingredients and products (for example `unit`, `kg`, `litre`); convert purchased quantities to the ingredient's unit before updating stock.
- To avoid duplicates, list expenses of the provider and date and compare `receiptNumber` and `amount` before creating one.
- `fudo_create_expense_payment` pays an expense; `status` turns PAID when it is fully paid.

## Writes
Creating and updating customers, expenses, expense payments and categories, providers, products and ingredients is included but installed switched off; turn them on deliberately. Write bodies use JSON:API (`data.type`, `data.attributes`, `data.relationships`). Rate limiting answers 429.

FUDO_API_KEY.label: API key (apiKey)
FUDO_API_KEY.help: The apiKey Fudo support sent you for the API user. Request it at soporte@fu.do with your account name and the user to enable.

FUDO_API_SECRET.label: API secret (apiSecret)
FUDO_API_SECRET.help: The apiSecret sent together with the apiKey.

verifyHints.400: Fudo refused the login. Check that the apiKey and apiSecret are the pair Fudo support issued and were pasted without spaces.
verifyHints.401: Fudo did not accept the credentials. Check the apiKey and apiSecret; if they are right, ask soporte@fu.do whether API access is still enabled for that user.
verifyHints.403: The API user's role does not allow this. In Fudo, give the API user a role with the permissions for the data you need (sales, products, expenses...); fudo_list_roles shows each role's permissions.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Fudo is rate limiting the requests. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: fudo_list_customers
tools.description: List the restaurant's customers with name, phone, e-mail, address, sales count, first and last sale date and house account. Filter by activity, origin, sales count or a free-text search.

search.description: Full-text search over the customer fields, e.g. maria gomez.

active.description: true for active customers, false for inactive ones.

origin.description: eq.ONLINE-MENU, eq.RESERVATION or is.null (created in the POS).

sales_count.description: Operator expression on the number of sales, e.g. gte.5 or and(gte.2,lte.10).

last_sale_date.description: Last sale time. Operator expression: gte.<time>, lte.<time> or and(gte.<time>,lte.<time>), times as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

first_sale_date.description: First sale time. Operator expression: gte.<time>, lte.<time> or and(gte.<time>,lte.<time>), times as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name, salesCount; prefix - for descending, e.g. -salesCount,name.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id with contact data, fiscal address, discount percentage, house account flag, sales count and first and last sale dates.

tools.name: fudo_list_products
tools.description: List products on the menu with name, code, price, cost, stock, stock control, active flag and position. Filter by name, category, active or ids; embed the category or modifiers with include.

name.description: Case-insensitive name match; % is the wildcard, e.g. %pizza%.

product_category_id.description: Only products of this category id.

active.description: true for active products, false for inactive ones.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed, e.g. productCategory, productModifiersGroups.productModifiers, proportions.ingredient, unit, menuItems.menu.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name, position; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id with price, cost, stock, description and flags; embed category, modifiers, recipe proportions or menus with include.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed, e.g. productCategory, productModifiersGroups.productModifiers, proportions.ingredient, unit, menuItems.menu.

tools.name: fudo_list_product_categories
tools.description: List product categories (menu sections) with name, position, parent category and kitchen. Embed products, kitchen, parent category or taxes with include.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name, position; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_product_category
tools.description: Get one product category by id with name and position; embed its products, kitchen, parent category or taxes with include.

tools.name: fudo_list_sales
tools.description: List sales (tickets) with total, type (eat-in, takeaway, delivery), state, people, customer name and created and closed times. Filter by period, state, type, table, waiter or payment method; embed items and payments with include.

created_at.description: Creation time. Operator expression: gte.<time>, lte.<time> or and(gte.<time>,lte.<time>), times as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

closed_at.description: Closing time range, only as and(gte.<time>,lt.<time>), e.g. and(gte.2026-10-01T00:00:00Z,lt.2026-10-02T00:00:00Z).

sale_state.description: in.(...) with any of PENDING, CANCELED, CLOSED, IN-COURSE, PAYMENT-PROCESS, DELIVERY-SENT, READY-TO-DELIVER, e.g. in.(CLOSED).

sale_type.description: Operator expression on the sale type, e.g. in.(EAT-IN,TAKEAWAY) or eq.DELIVERY.

table_id.description: Only sales of this table id.

user_id.description: Only sales of this user (waiter) id.

payment_method_id.description: eq.<id> or in.(<id>,<id>) on the payment method.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed, e.g. items.product, payments.paymentMethod, customer, discounts, tips, table.room, waiter, commercialDocuments, shippingCosts.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, createdAt, closedAt; prefix - for descending, e.g. -createdAt.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_sale
tools.description: Get one sale by id with total, type, state, people, comment and times; embed the items with products, payments, discounts, tips, customer and table with include.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed, e.g. items.product, payments.paymentMethod, customer, discounts, tips, table.room, waiter, commercialDocuments, shippingCosts.

tools.name: fudo_list_payments
tools.description: List payments received with amount, payment method, paid and created times and canceled flag. Filter by time, amount or canceled; embed the payment method with include. Use it for cash-up and revenue by method. Sale payments and expense payments come back together; separate them with expense_id.

created_at.description: Creation time. Operator expression: gte.<time>, lte.<time> or and(gte.<time>,lte.<time>), times as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

paid_at.description: Payment time. Operator expression: gte.<time>, lte.<time> or and(gte.<time>,lte.<time>), times as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

amount.description: Operator expression on the amount, e.g. gte.1000.

canceled.description: eq.true for canceled payments only, neq.true to leave them out.

expense_id.description: is.null for sale payments only, isdistinct.null for expense (supplier) payments only.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_payment
tools.description: Get one payment by id with amount, received amount, paid time, external reference and canceled flag; embed the payment method with include.

tools.name: fudo_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods configured in Fudo (cash, cards, transfers, online processors) with id, name and kind. Use the ids to filter sales and payments.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses (purchases and costs) with amount, date, due date, payment date, description, status (PAID or UNPAID) and receipt number. Filter by date, status, category, provider or payment method. Embed the purchased lines with include=expenseItems.ingredient.unit.

date.description: Expense date: gte.<date> or and(gte.<date>,lte.<date>), dates as 2026-10-01.

expense_category_id.description: eq.<id> or in.(<id>,<id>) on the expense category.

provider_id.description: Only expenses of this provider (supplier) id.

canceled.description: eq.true for canceled only, neq.true to leave them out.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed: expenseItems.ingredient.unit and expenseItems.product.unit (the purchased lines with ingredient or product and unit), provider, expenseCategory, paymentMethod, payments.paymentMethod, user, cashRegister, receiptType.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, createdAt, date, dueDate; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_expense
tools.description: Get one expense by id with amount, dates, description, status and receipt number. Embed the purchased lines with include=expenseItems.ingredient.unit, and provider, category or payments.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed: expenseItems.ingredient.unit and expenseItems.product.unit (the purchased lines with ingredient or product and unit), provider, expenseCategory, paymentMethod, payments.paymentMethod, user, cashRegister, receiptType.

tools.name: fudo_list_expense_categories
tools.description: List expense categories with id, name, active flag, financial category (ADMINISTRATIVE-EXPENSES, OPERATIONAL-EXPENSES, GOODS-PURCHASES) and parent category. Use the ids to filter or create expenses.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_list_tables
tools.description: List the dining tables with number, room and status. Embed the open sales on each table with include=activeSales to see which tables are occupied and their running totals.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed, e.g. room, activeSales, activeSales.items.product, activeSales.payments, activeSales.customer.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, number; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_table
tools.description: Get one table by id with number and room; embed its open sales with items and payments with include.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to embed, e.g. room, activeSales, activeSales.items.product, activeSales.payments, activeSales.customer.

tools.name: fudo_list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms (dining areas such as salon or terrace) with id and name; embed their tables with include=tables.

include.description: tables to embed the tables of each room.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_list_kitchens
tools.description: List the kitchens (preparation stations such as kitchen or bar) with id and name. Product categories are routed to a kitchen.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_list_providers
tools.description: List providers (suppliers) with name, e-mail, phone, address, fiscal number and house account balance. Filter by active or a free-text search.

active.description: true for active providers, false for inactive ones.

search.description: Full-text search over the provider fields.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_provider
tools.description: Get one provider (supplier) by id with name, e-mail, phone, address, fiscal number, comment, active flag and house account balance.

tools.name: fudo_list_ingredients
tools.description: List ingredients with cost, stock, minimum stock and stock control. Filter by name, category or ids. Add include=unit to get the unit name (unit, kg, litre) in included. Use it for stock checks and before fudo_update_ingredient.

name.description: Case-insensitive name match; % is the wildcard, e.g. %tomate%.

ingredient_category_id.description: Only ingredients of this category id.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_get_ingredient
tools.description: Get one ingredient by id with cost, stock, minimum stock and stock control. Add include=unit for the unit name. Read it right before fudo_update_ingredient to get the current stock.

tools.name: fudo_list_users
tools.description: List the Fudo users (staff such as waiters and cashiers) with name, e-mail and active flag; embed their role or cash registers with include. Use the ids to filter sales by waiter.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_list_roles
tools.description: List user roles with name and permissions (e.g. list_expenses, create_expenses, view_products_cost). Use it to explain a 403: the API can only do what the API user's role allows.

sort.description: Comma-separated: id, name; prefix - for descending.

page_size.description: Items per page, up to 500 (default 250). The last page has fewer items than this.

tools.name: fudo_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer in Fudo with name and optional contact data. Fudo requires a default payment method for the customer. Returns the new customer with its id.

payment_method_id.description: Default payment method id, from fudo_list_payment_methods.

house_account_enabled.description: Allow the customer to buy on account.

tools.name: fudo_update_customer
tools.description: Change a customer's contact data, discount, house account or active flag. Only the fields given are sent; Fudo also requires the default payment method. Returns the updated customer.

tools.name: fudo_create_expense
tools.description: Record an expense (purchase, bill or cost) with amount and date, and link it to a provider, category or payment method. The Fudo API cannot add purchased lines (expense items) to an expense, so it does not change stock: to raise ingredient stock after a purchase, use fudo_update_ingredient. Returns the new expense id.

use_in_cash_count.description: true when paid from the cash register, so it counts in the cash-up.

relationships.description: JSON:API links by id, e.g. {"provider": {"data": {"id": "7", "type": "Provider"}}, "expenseCategory": {"data": {"id": "3", "type": "ExpenseCategory"}}, "paymentMethod": {"data": {"id": "1", "type": "PaymentMethod"}}}. Also cashRegister, receiptType and commercialDocument.

tools.name: fudo_update_expense
tools.description: Change an expense: amount, date, description, receipt number, due or payment date, cash-count flag, or cancel it with canceled=true. Only the fields given are sent. Returns the updated expense.

use_in_cash_count.description: true when paid from the cash register.

relationships.description: JSON:API links by id, e.g. {"provider": {"data": {"id": "7", "type": "Provider"}}, "expenseCategory": {"data": {"id": "3", "type": "ExpenseCategory"}}, "paymentMethod": {"data": {"id": "1", "type": "PaymentMethod"}}}. Also cashRegister, receiptType and commercialDocument.

tools.name: fudo_create_expense_payment
tools.description: Pay an expense: record a payment of an amount with a payment method, so the expense turns PAID once fully paid. Returns the new payment id.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method id from fudo_list_payment_methods (one with forExpenses).

tools.name: fudo_create_expense_category
tools.description: Create an expense category with a name, optional financial category and parent category. Returns the new category id.

financial_category.description: Financial category; GOODS-PURCHASES for stock purchases.

tools.name: fudo_create_provider
tools.description: Create a provider (supplier) with a name and optional fiscal number, e-mail, phone, address and comment. Check fudo_list_providers with search first to avoid duplicates. Returns the new provider id.

tools.name: fudo_update_provider
tools.description: Change a provider's name, fiscal number, e-mail, phone, address, comment or active flag. Only the fields given are sent. Returns the updated provider.

tools.name: fudo_update_product
tools.description: Change a product's price, cost, stock, minimum stock, name, code, description or active flag. Only the fields given are sent. stock is the new absolute level, not a delta. Returns the updated product.

active.description: false to take the product off sale.

tools.name: fudo_update_ingredient
tools.description: Change an ingredient's stock, cost, minimum stock, name or stock control. stock is the new absolute level, not a delta: after a purchase, read the current stock with fudo_get_ingredient and send current + purchased quantity, in the ingredient's unit. Only the fields given are sent. Returns the updated ingredient.

stock.description: New stock level in the ingredient's unit (absolute, not a delta).
